items.subject: PCVJ_E001
items.classification: stager refused an unmatched opacity entry (checkpoint_size is reachable only through resume, which E001 had made opaque); shape changed in E002 by not making resume opaque (resume is expanded, as the P2j tx2_common emission did).

items.subject: PCVJ_E003
items.classification: timeout at 180 s during the cold build of the solana dependency tree in the fresh workspace (charon had not finished cargo); not a translation failure. P1c met the same (PCQC_E013 timeout, then PCQC_E023 success after the target directory was warm). E004 is run with a changed shape (stage1_owned root only) so that it is not an unchanged rerun; the continuing cargo cache is state, recorded here.
